title: The merge tool tells a gate job that never ran from a red one
why: A GitHub fault left batch 81's gate jobs with no runner; the merge tool read the roll-up as red, offered no way out, and GitHub refused a re-run of failed jobs.
note: Batch 81, run 43088666860: every needed job passed, but all-jobs-passed and ci-done never got a runner (GitHub internal error). The owner allowed --base-red-ok at 15:39 CST; the merge tool still refused on the run's red roll-up with no override; "Re-run failed jobs" got 403 "This workflow run cannot be retried". Ask: the merge tool tells a gate job that never got a runner from a red job, and names the way out (a full re-run, or the owner's named act). A test goes red on today's code. Waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51).
